Profile Phensuximide is a succinimide antiepileptic with actions similar to those of ethosuximide (p.479), but it is reported to be less ef- fective. Porphyria. Phensuximide has been associated with acute at- tacks of porphyria and is considered unsafe in porphyric patients. Preparations USP 31: Phensuximide Capsules.
